normalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 rendered row text after ANSI-control removal and outer-whitespace trimming. Targeted rows also pin the exact post-redaction raw-row and rendered-row SHA-256 values.
policy: History-excluded residual detectors found vertical phrases, generic template copy, cut/splice markers, and explicit filler. Rows were accepted only after full-payload review and independent cross-check confirmed that redaction preserves retained ANSI controls, CP437 source cells, colors, backgrounds, terminal-art glyphs, spacing, and geometry. Whole-row blanking is used only for completely disposable rows; mixed functional rows use one-based inclusive source-cell ranges with fail-closed pre- and post-redaction hashes.

candidates.rationale: Independent full-payload and projection review confirmed that the selected placeholder or source-editing copy is separable from retained artwork, titles, attribution, and functional interface text. Exact hashes lock both the reviewed source and any targeted-column projection.
